driver: Loss is generated per event and borne by every unit still in custody when it starts, so a forward plan that only re-sequences the same work multiplies the exposure integral at unchanged rates; the rule, recovered from closed investigations and run over the plan's sequence, turns the figure up after every rate correction walked it down.
driver_concrete: A qualifying reefer excursion writes off every consignment still aboard at onset (48 of 48 closed investigations), so loss scales with pack-legs; the Q4 plan puts hospital drops last on every merged run, pack-legs per pack go from 2.98 to 8.34, and 48 per 35,676 calls on 1,055,638 planned pack-legs gives 1,420.3 packs.
stump: A competent solver strips the withdrawn credits and the resolved Haydock cold-store losses and carries the transit write-off rate per pack onto the plan's volume, filing about 510 packs (790 on QA's depot-rate basis), never computing packs aboard per call on the plan's merged run sequence.
notes: Design note: no A to E pattern is decisive (the unit of independent risk is not the unit of record) and B pins only the machinery, so pattern is none and the decisive G-code is G14-flavoured exposure conditioning.
